scope: Read-only matched native source and completed gravity trace audit; no runtime/test tolerance change.
facts: island_solver.rs adds island additional solver iterations to the base count and divides dt by that count.
velocity_solver.rs computes force times effective inverse mass times the divided dt, then adds that increment in each small step.
Application bodies request8 additional iterations on top of the configured16; confirm the actual body values in the native gravity replay.
rigid_body_components.rs computes user force plus gravity times mass times gravity scale before the velocity solver; all operators use Real=f32 for this backend.
limits: This is a free body scalar velocity recurrence, not a contact, constraint, damping or trajectory model.
No production physical tolerance changes are proposed.
